text: To the Black Sea. The Kyiv Independent reports a shadow-fleet tanker reportedly ablaze near Sochi, and Russian Telegram channels suggest sea drones hit it. Robert Brovdi, call sign Madyar, who commands Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces, says his units recorded 2,699 Russian troops killed or wounded from October 1 to 5, up from 1,931 in the same days of September. And in broadcast number 1216, Yuri Shvets lays out what he calls six priorities for victory: six lines of effort that must work at once, instead of slogans and promises of another counteroffensive.
